description: This Java class 'Breadcrumb' represents a breadcrumb trail element in a web application. It manages breadcrumb items, their type, associated language, and URL reference content.

classes.name: Breadcrumb
classes.description: A serializable class representing a breadcrumb navigation element, holding breadcrumb items, language, type, and URL reference.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the breadcrumb.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language associated with the breadcrumb.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Sets the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Defines the type of breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Gets the type of breadcrumb item.
